changeSet.comment: Hephaestus in numbers: one row for each released half-year, with only the figures that passed the disclosure rules (ADR 0153).

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Whether an instance admin turned Hephaestus in numbers on; null leaves the configured default.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The periods and figures an instance admin withdrew from Hephaestus in numbers, for good.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A released half-year of Hephaestus in numbers starts on 1 April or 1 October and lasts six months, so two periods never overlap (ADR 0153).

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A released half-year is never computed again: the database refuses to change or delete it (ADR 0153).

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Turning Hephaestus in numbers on or off, and each withdrawal from it, lands on the auth event trail. NOT VALID adds the wider check without a scan of the ledger; the next change set validates it.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; ALTER TABLE auth_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('USER_VIEW', 'LOGIN', 'PASSKEY_CHANGED', 'PASSKEY_VERIFIED', 'LOGIN_FAILED', 'LOGOUT', 'TOKEN_REFRESH', 'JWT_REVOKED', 'IDENTITY_LINKED', 'IDENTITY_UNLINKED', 'IMPERSONATION_BEGIN', 'IMPERSONATION_END', 'ACCOUNT_DELETED', 'EXPORT_REQUESTED', 'PERSON_DATA_PREVIEWED', 'PERSON_DATA_EXPORTED', 'PERSON_DATA_ERASURE_REQUESTED', 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED', 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED', 'RESEARCH_CONSENT_REVOKED', 'WORKSPACE_ELEVATION', 'INSTALLATION_EVENT_REPLAYED', 'GITHUB_INSTALLATION_ADOPTED', 'GITHUB_INSTALLATION_DECLINED', 'WORKSPACE_OWNER_CHANGE', 'WORKSPACE_DELETION', 'PROVIDER_RESOURCE_RELEASE', 'PRACTICE_REPOSITORY_CHANGE', 'LLM_CONNECTION_CREATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_UPDATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_CREATED', 'LLM_MODEL_UPDATED', 'LLM_MODEL_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_PRICE_CHANGED', 'LLM_MODEL_SHARING_CHANGED', 'LLM_SETTINGS_CHANGED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_CREATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_UPDATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_DELETED', 'SILENT_MODE_CHANGED', 'PUBLIC_ACTIVITY_CHANGED', 'PUBLIC_USAGE_CHANGED', 'PUBLIC_USAGE_WITHDRAWN', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DESTINATIONS_CHANGED', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_CLEANUP_CONFIRMED', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_FILED_BY_ADMIN', 'RESEARCH_DATASET_RELEASED', 'RESEARCH_REMOVAL_RECORDED', 'MCP_CLIENT_APPROVED', 'MCP_CLIENT_REFUSED', 'MCP_CLIENT_REVOKED')) NOT VALID

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Validates the wider auth event check apart from its change, so the ledger is not locked during the scan.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; ALTER TABLE auth_event VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type
